body:
# Spawn Nether Roof
This datapack, makes you appear on the roof of the nether, and if you die, you'll respawn there too.

# Translation
If you'd like to help us translate the datapack, you can do so [here](https://crowdin.com/project/horas-datapack-traduction). If you speak any of the following languages, we'd greatly appreciate your assistance: German, Italian, Japanese, Norwegian, Russian, Spanish, and Swedish.

## Features
You spawn on the Nether roof, and if you die, you'll respawn there too.

## Compatibility
1.21.3 ✅ | 1.21.2 ✅
